items.quote: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;
items.claim: The text says Jethro, the priest of Midian and Moses' father-in-law, heard what God had done for Moses and Israel, including bringing Israel out of Egypt.
items.object: God's deeds for Moses and Israel; the exodus from Egypt
items.mechanism: News of the exodus reached Jethro, which leads into the reunion in 18:2-6.

items.quote: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back, 18:3 And her two sons;
items.claim: The text says Jethro took Zipporah, Moses' wife, whom Moses had earlier sent back, along with her two sons.
items.mechanism: Zipporah had been sent back to her father's household before this.

items.quote: of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
items.claim: The text names one son Gershom and explains the name by Moses' words that he had been an alien in a strange land.
items.mechanism: The name is explained by Moses' time living as a foreigner.

items.quote: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
items.claim: The text names the other son Eliezer and explains the name by Moses' words that his father's God helped him and saved him from Pharaoh's sword.
items.mechanism: The name is explained by Moses' rescue from Pharaoh.

items.quote: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
items.claim: The text says Jethro came with Moses' wife and sons to Moses in the wilderness, where Moses was camped at the mount of God.
items.place: the wilderness, at the mount of God
items.mechanism: Jethro brought Moses' family back to him.

items.quote: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
items.claim: The text says Jethro told Moses that he had come to him with Moses' wife and her two sons.
items.place: the wilderness, at the mount of God
items.mechanism: Jethro announces his arrival and the return of Moses' family.
